import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem unbounded_quotient_classification (k q : ℕ) : 2003 + 11 * k = 11 * q + 1 ↔ q = 182 + k := by
  constructor
  · 
    intro h
    have h₁ : 2003 + 11 * k = 11 * q + 1 := h
    have h₂ : q = 182 + k := by
      
      omega
    exact h₂
  · 
    intro h
    have h₁ : q = 182 + k := h
    have h₂ : 2003 + 11 * k = 11 * q + 1 := by
      
      rw [h₁]
      <;> ring_nf
      <;> omega
    exact h₂
